title: Uphill path boundary hedge
duration_policy: One-second micro-study when supported; shortest actually offered surface. Use six-second conditional prompt only if six seconds is the observed UI minimum. Record interface/model/minimum/date. No API execution or key requested by this handoff.

bound_references.human_decision: approved source reused; exact crop and proposed action pending packet review
approved source reused; exact crop and proposed action pending packet review

must_move: the whole leaf sprays of the shrubs beside the uphill path flex gently from fixed stems; the connected hillside itself never bends
must_not_move: every path pixel, path width and edges, ground, houses, rocks and mountains
end_state: original rooted silhouette, no abrupt loop snap
negative_constraints: no identity, topology or palette drift
no camera motion, HUD or text
interface_contract: Upload IMAGE_1 as the initial image on single-image I2V. IMAGE_2 is a detail of that same painting for operator identity/material review, not an alternative layout or second timeline frame. Preserve native aspect.
return_requirements: native video file committed in return branch, not merely a JSON path/hash
full-speed review and frame-by-frame ground/path stability
reject stalled repeated poses, branch melting, sliding roots and global grade change

conditional_prompt_variants.hold_purpose: unavoidable interface tail after complete micro-study; not runtime animation or concealed missing action
